actions.command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'PATH=%s\n' "$PATH"
command -v qemu-system-x86_64 || true
command -v qemu-system-i386 || true
command -v telnet || true
command -v nc || true
command -v socat || true
ls -l /app || true
find /app -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed 's#^#/##' | sort | head -200
